history.body: Hi, I came across Pearl Residences while browsing around Seberang Jaya. What’s the general price range there? I’m just trying to get a feel for the area and options.

As a rough guide, the base-price references I have are around RM328k–RM358k, depending on floor and facing. That isn’t a confirmed current all-in price—the car-park configuration and latest package can affect the final figure, so I’ll verify the current schedule before quoting an exact amount. If you have a rough budget ceiling, I can help narrow down the options.
I’m hoping to stay around RM350,000, though I’m still figuring out what the full costs look like. If the current range is confirmed, could you let me know whether anything is near that amount?

The earlier indicative base-price references were around RM328k–RM358k, so that range does include figures near your RM350k target. But I can’t confirm whether a current unit is available at that level or what the all-in price would be yet; the car-park configuration and current package can affect the total. For an ongoing cost reference, maintenance for the 900 sq ft unit is about RM162/month, inclusive of sinking fund. I’ll share the confirmed price and inclusions once they’re available.
